svg.title: The cost comes now, for certain, and the vision someday, maybe, with your line between them.
svg.desc: Three things in a row. On the left, the cost, which comes now and for certain. An arrow marked "for the mission" runs from it toward the right. On the right, one large circle with a dotted outline: the vision, which may come someday. Between them stands a heavy line, where the arrow stops. It is highlighted: your line, drawn before anyone asks.
